reviews.decision_reason: map_coverage matches exact need text to capability rows, preserves the allowed record IDs, and marks missing capability matches as unsupported. The observed coverage output is consistent with the supplied needs and capabilities.

prioritize_needs inverts the unsupported flag by setting unsupported to true when coverage == 'direct'. That causes covered needs to be ranked ahead of actually unsupported needs, contradicting the declared role to rank unsupported needs before covered needs using upstream rank within each group. The final priorities show this inversion: direct coverage records are marked unsupported:true and appear before the actual unsupported records.

synthesize_recommendation retains the explicit eight-item window and derives the recommendation from the already-ranked first priority record. The observed bad top need is downstream of the malformed priority table, not localized to this boundary.
